_how: The PM's to-do, shown first on the HTML dashboard. The PM, 2026-10-15: "If I ever ask what I need to do then add it to my dashboard." Whenever the PM asks what he needs to do, add each step here; remove it the moment it is done. Fields: p (1 = do first, 2, 3), text (what), how (one line), due (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), unlocks (what it unblocks, optional), url (optional), added (YYYY-MM-DD). Trimmed 2026-10-25 to the decision rights: only ideas, version scope, words and look-and-feel, and actions only the PM can take (accounts, people); at most 10 items and 3 P1. ONE AT A TIME (the PM, 2026-10-26, option C of the harness grade): `items` holds the single item in front of the PM; `queue` holds the rest in order. When the PM answers, Dispatch moves the next item from `queue` into `items`. The dashboard reads `items` only.

items.text: Review the one-page rules list (wording only)
items.how: Read the short list at the top: the soul, the defaults and the principles under them. Change any word you want; everything else is already decided and applied.
items.unlocks: Every agent decides by these words from now on

queue.how:
Phone, socialus.org. You need THREE accounts: your main (owns the Page), a second email, and a third. A Gmail '+' address works as the third, e.g. yourname+two@gmail.com: same inbox, counts as a different member. Sign in on the second and third with the 6-digit code from the email; never use a builder account (they never send notices).
1. Second account: open a Page your main account owns, tap ⋯ → Report this Page, pick Spam (NOT Sensitive content or Threat of harm: those hide at once), type 'TEST', Send. Page stays up.
2. Main account: open You. A courtesy notice about the report is there, and the Page still shows its name and description.
3. Second account again: report the same Page a second time. Nothing changes (the same person twice does not count; a third try says you already reported it). Fine.
4. Third account: report the same Page, Spam, 'TEST'. Now a second member has reported it: the name and description disappear for everyone, the Page stays up, and your main account gets a 'hidden' notice.
5. Undo: in Admin → Reports, restore the Page's words.
Then tell an agent 'F078 test done': it checks the AI shadow row and closes #220 and #486's check.
queue.unlocks: Closes web #220, clears the 10-27 photo tripwire, and proves the AI shadow read runs (#486)
